texts.tapTogether: Let us keep this race moving! Tap the screen and cheer for your favourite driver!
texts.joinActivity: Want to join the race? Comment a car number. Stay active with likes or the gift shown for your car. Active players can take an available place. If every driver is active, you will stay in the waiting list.
texts.countryCheer: Where are you watching from? Write your country in the comments and let us see your flag!
texts.giftInvite: If you would like to send a gift, choose the gift shown for your car. Likes are welcome too. Thank you for every kind of support!
texts.likeSprint: Ready for a tapping sprint? Every ten likes gives your car one helping point. Keep your team moving!
texts.closeRace: Look at those drivers! Keep cheering, keep tapping, and enjoy the race together!
texts.freeSupport: You can support the race for free! Tap the screen, share the live, and invite a friend to join us!
texts.mixedSupport: Like or gift to move! Choose your car and stay active. More activity helps you keep your place in the race.
texts.countryReply: Your country choice is saved! Look for your flag beside your name when you join a car.
texts.helloReply: Hello! Welcome to the race! Comment your country, choose a car number, and join the fun!
texts.carReply: Your car request is recorded. Keep active with the controls shown for this race. If every car is full and active, please wait for an available place.
texts.helpReply: To play, comment a car number. In like mode, every ten likes gives one helping point. In gift mode, send the gift shown for your car. Likes or gifts work together in mixed mode.
texts.cheerReply: I see your support in the comments! Keep cheering for your driver. Let us make this a great race!
texts.thanksReply: You are very welcome! Thank you for being here and supporting the race!
texts.giftJoin: Want to take part? Comment a car number and send the gift shown for your car. Active players can take an available place. A full race keeps your request in the waiting list.
